         DIRECTREACH
         ============================================================ -->
    <div class="startup-card">
      <div class="startup-card-left">
        <div class="startup-emoji">🎯</div>

      <div class="startup-card-right">
        <h3 class="startup-title">DirectReach</h3>
        <p class="startup-tagline">Cut the middleman. Grow the business. — A flat-fee platform that sends customers directly to small businesses.</p>
        <div class="startup-section">
          <strong>Problem</strong>
          <p>Every small business needs marketing, but the biggest platforms (Groupon, Turo, Angi, DoorDash) take 25–50% of revenue per transaction just for lead generation. The platform grows rich; the business owner scrapes by. With 33M+ small businesses in the US alone paying billions in commissions, the pain is massive and universal.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="startup-section">
          <strong>Solution</strong>
          <p>DirectReach gives each business one clean listing page showing their top 5 products/services with real prices, a booking link, phone number, website, and aggregated reviews from Google & Yelp — all for a flat monthly subscription ($0–$99/mo). No per-transaction cut. Customers connect directly with the business. 100% of revenue stays with the owner.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="startup-section">
          <strong>Why now?</strong>
          <p>Platform fatigue is real — small business owners are increasingly vocal about commission-based models eating their margins. The rise of "support local" sentiment, combined with growing distrust of Yelp and Groupon's opaque algorithms, creates an opening for a transparency-first alternative. The subscription SaaS model is proven; applying it to local discovery is the insight.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="startup-section">
          <strong>Market</strong>
          <p>$25B+ total addressable market in platform commissions (US). Primary targets: restaurants, home services, auto rentals, beauty & wellness, and event venues — any SMB currently paying $500+/month to commission-based platforms.</p>
        </div>

          <span class="tag">Small Business</span>
          <span class="tag">Lead Generation</span>
        </div>
